With the ridge mapper at its selected k=20, Llama 3.1 8B→70B transfer gets **57.78% on MMLU** and **14.78% on GSM8K** (Table 13, p. 18).

For comparison, from the same table (p. 18):
- **The 70B model on its own** scores 78.84% on MMLU and 81.12% on GSM8K.
- **The 8B model on its own** scores 64.97% on MMLU and 56.10% on GSM8K.

So on both benchmarks the transfer scores below even the smaller 8B source model.

The main text reports the same pair as retention, meaning transfer accuracy as a share of the 70B model's own score: 73.3% on MMLU and 18.2% on GSM8K (Table 1, p. 6). Retention is defined on p. 6. Table 1 also confirms the selected k is 20 and that the mapper is ridge in content-space (p. 6).
